data.title: Registered Nurse at a Health Centre
data.summary: The role provides outpatient nursing care to patients of different ages through in-person, telephone and digital services. Work includes care needs assessment, non-urgent appointments, patient office duties and urgent care shifts in a multidisciplinary team.

requirements.question: What does 'good IT skills' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting calls for good IT skills without naming the systems or tasks involved.

requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting asks for fluent Finnish, while Swedish and English are described as advantages.

requirements.text: Stress tolerance, initiative and enjoyment of teamwork
requirements.question: What does 'stress tolerance and a proactive teamwork approach' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting describes the desired nurse through broad personal qualities and approach to teamwork.

requirements.text: Registration as a licensed registered nurse
Vaccination protection required by the Communicable Diseases Act
Tuberculosis clearance required by the Communicable Diseases Act
Active attitude, flexibility, customer service and teamwork skills
requirements.question: What does 'an active attitude and flexibility' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting values several broad personal qualities alongside customer service and teamwork skills.

requirements.text: Previous experience of health centre work
